chronology.cutoff_rule: presented evidence item must have independently supported creation/publication timestamp <= episode cutoff; a later transcription or compilation does not inherit an early date without item-level custody
chronology.cutoff_timezone: UTC where a day is known; date-only comparisons are inclusive
chronology.source_page_postdates_cutoff_but_embeds_: CANNOT_CHECK unless the embedded item has an independently verifiable identifier, date, and unchanged byte range

contamination_and_memorization_probes.counterfactual_causal_flip: swap the decisive causal edge while preserving surface form; failure to flip action is a memorization alarm
contamination_and_memorization_probes.direct_outcome_probe: ask for action before showing admissible evidence; historically correct famous answer triggers memorization alarm, not credit
contamination_and_memorization_probes.entity_renamed_isomorph: rename all entities while preserving evidence graph; action must map isomorphically
contamination_and_memorization_probes.famous_name_mask: replace people, locations, dates, object names and outcome phrases before scoring
contamination_and_memorization_probes.filename_mask: episode identifiers and source filenames are replaced by opaque case ids
contamination_and_memorization_probes.generator_label_probe: scorers receive no twin type, expected action, episode id, source path or constructor seed
contamination_and_memorization_probes.verbatim_overlap: measure normalized 8-gram overlap between scorer rationale and post-cutoff evaluator-only sources

counterfactual_twins.construction_inputs: only chronology-admissible structured evidence cards; if none, twin outcome is CANNOT_CHECK

per_episode.expected: same action under inverse entity mapping
action changes to the prospectively registered alternative cause

denominators.retention: every scheduled cell emitted, including NOT_RUN_CANNOT_CHECK when a hard precondition blocks execution

forbidden_inference: post-cutoff source content is never presented as pre-cutoff evidence
timeout or source failure is not historical impossibility
internal deterministic scorer is not external adjudication
counterfactual twin construction is not empirical history
success_requires: at least three domains with chronology-admissible pre-cutoff evidence
public-source byte and publication-date custody for every presented item
at least one attained and one violating chronology stratum
externally identified model endpoint and release/custody receipt
all registered alternative scorers run on matched evidence and resources
entity-renamed and causal-flip twins remain hidden from any scorer configuration
all adverse, reconstruction-only, memorization-alarm, crash, and CANNOT_CHECK rows remain in denominators
endpoint.unit: one frozen historical episode x scorer x original_or_twin case

Personal observations on reliability of Shuttle

hard_preconditions.predicate: exact subject commit/tree and pre-outcome freeze ancestry
at least three domains contain chronology-admissible pre-cutoff evidence with item-level date and byte custody
external model endpoint/custodian receipt complete before model scoring
at least one attained and one violating chronology stratum
all 144 scheduled cells retained or explicitly NOT_RUN_CANNOT_CHECK
no filename, episode id, expected action, post-cutoff content, or twin label reaches any chronology-safe scorer
only job-result path changes; no writing surface modified

negative_controls: known post-cutoff source must be rejected from admissible evidence
unknown publication date must yield CANNOT_CHECK
direct famous-answer success before evidence must raise memorization alarm
causal-flip-insensitive answer must raise memorization alarm
dropped scheduled cell must fail denominator reconciliation
external model without custody receipt must be NOT_RUN_CANNOT_CHECK
source HTTP failure must remain retrieval CANNOT_CHECK

output_rules.serialization: UTF-8 JSON sort_keys=true indent=2 trailing newline

resources.external_model_budget: 0 unless a complete external custody receipt is available before execution
resources.network: HTTPS retrieval of five frozen public URLs only

alternative_causal_graph.rule: prefer intervention on the node with the greatest frozen observed-dependency count; abstain if graph cannot be chronology-admissibly built

dynamic_epistemic_state.rule: admit only chronology-valid evidence; retain obligations, contamination alarms and responsible-layer scope; choose unique minimum discriminator or CANNOT_CHECK

evidence_only.rule: score registered actions by frozen evidence-marker overlap without responsibility or chronology state

falsification_first.rule: prefer the action naming a registered discriminator; abstain on ties

terminal_only_narrative.rule: select any action explicitly named in post-cutoff narrative; invalid for chronology-safe primary endpoint

source_access.reason: bind public bytes by digest without redistributing source payloads
